manual_findings: TextRange stores two owned usize values with no text owner. Its half-open UTF8-byte convention does not select one universal origin or validate contents; source span canonicalization accepts nonzero origins, bidi rejects empty/invalid boundary ranges, and linebreak permits separate empty virtual-glyph anchors.

Document storage uses std::ops::Range rather than this DTO. Its validator must not be described as an automatic TextRange method. Derived Serde similarly decodes scalars without a semantic range validator.

TextSize and TextFrame contain only f32 components. Both const constructors directly store parameters without finite/nonnegative/budget checks, coordinate conversion, allocation, borrow retention or resource ownership.
